name: @caseflow-ai/desktop
description: CASEFlow AI desktop edition (Electron, DEC-117, DEC-120)

scripts.build:all: node scripts/build-web.mjs && pnpm run build && pnpm run build:api
scripts.build:api: pnpm --filter @caseflow-ai/api run build && pnpm --filter @caseflow-ai/api deploy --prod --legacy --config.node-linker=hoisted build/api && pnpm install --config.confirm-modules-purge=false
